message: Hi, my kid Zoe is 9 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! Zoe would be a great fit for our Juniors Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class, which is for kids ages 7-12. We'd love to have her try a free trial class to see how she likes it. Would you like to get that set up?
Yes, that sounds great! When's the next available trial class?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! What's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.onyx@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Zoe's full name and date of birth to get her trial booked.
Zoe's full name is Zoe Onyx, and her birthday is August 30, 2017.

Perfect! I have some great options for Zoe's trial class this week:

Wednesday 7/8 at 5:00 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 5:00 PM
Friday 7/10 at 5:00 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Wednesday, 7/8 at 5:00 PM.

Perfect! Zoe is all set for her free trial class on Wednesday, July 8th at 5:00 PM. We'll send the detaild to tester.onyx@gmail.com. Just have her wear comfortable athletic clothes. See you then!
